findings.title: Missing Schema.org Organization structured data on root landing page
findings.evidence:
Observed at https://react.dev/ via jsonld_schema_extractor [2026-08-31T15:50:46Z]: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks. (Confidence: high)
Additional evidence (citation-simulator): Observed at https://react.dev via onsite_answerability_probe [2026-08-31T15:50:47Z]: Across 5 crawled page(s), no Organization/LocalBusiness schema states who the brand is in machine-readable form. An assistant that fetched these pages could not quote an answer to "What is React?" from this site, so it must fall back to third-party sources or omit the brand. (Confidence: medium)

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script on the homepage declaring @type 'Organization' with name, url, logo, and sameAs links to authoritative profiles.

evidence_details.observation: Root homepage contains 0 Organization or LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema blocks.

findings.title: Missing XML sitemap declared in robots.txt or available at /sitemap.xml
findings.evidence: Observed at https://react.dev/sitemap.xml via http_get_sitemap_check [2026-08-31T15:50:46Z]: Request to https://react.dev/sitemap.xml did not return a valid sitemap and no 'Sitemap:' directive was found in robots.txt. (Confidence: high)

suggested_action.how_to_fix: Generate an XML sitemap for public indexable URLs and add 'Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml' to robots.txt.
